body:
FOR WHOEVER BUILDS THIS: START HERE (refreshed 15 Nov 2026, design only, nothing built; replaces the 6 Nov detail). Full text: docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md, section P2-25, parts 1 to 17 (the design PR). The other notes on this item are the parts: the fold table and call sites, the repair, tests and what is not recoverable, and the questions for the advisor.

WHAT CHANGED SINCE 6 NOV. (1) The damage is wider than the empty key (all RUN on main 64f3067): a Latin artist with two different Arabic titles that start the same share fairuz|habibi| (not empty); an Arabic artist with one Latin title for two artists share |habibi|; the Latin letters that do not decompose are dropped (Bjork with o-slash is bjrk, Simarik with a dotless i is smark, Lukasz with l-stroke is ukasz, Strasse with the sharp s is strae); a curly apostrophe is dropped with no gap and a straight one is a gap, so the same song is two refs in Latin letters. (2) A file the old fold glued onto the wrong song STAYS there: scanner.link_library and migration._ref_for_song keep a file on the ref that holds it whatever its tags say. So prevention alone leaves the owner's collapsed library as it is. (3) The 6 Nov repair (detach and re-link) is replaced: MOVE the library files of suspect refs to their own songs inside the hourly library link (rehome.py). No id disappears, so there is no ref_merge row, no ref_gone row, no new feed; the phone learns from the files feed it already reads (files_since returns the current state of both refs). (4) N-34's skip rule is "the name survives the fold WHOLE" (textnorm.survives_fold_whole), NOT "the key is empty".

THE SLICES. 1 server + app: the core (fold, words, key_text, survives_fold_whole era 0), tools/gen_text_fold_table.py and the Dart table, app/lib/domain/text_fold.dart, ONE fixture app/test/fixtures/text/fold-cases.json read by both suites (the server workflow lists the folder), normalizeForMatch on the Dart fold; NO server caller moved. 2+3 ONE pull request: every call site moves, facts_to_fill, the dense-script rule, MATCHER_REVISION + 1; keyrepair.py (rekey at start-up before refmerge, backup first, one transaction, revision in setting), migration (ref_recheck, ref_merge.title and artist; take the NEXT FREE number at cut time: main has 0015, PR #94 holds 0016), refmerge holds a pair when a ref is on the worklist. 4 rehome.py in the library link + the phone's test of a split page + audit_stack check rekey.

WHO NEEDS IT: N-34 (repair hard need; slices 1-3 skip names that do not survive the fold whole), N-16 (declared), P2-12 slices 5, 6, 8 (the plan's own Order line), N-28 through P2-12, N-23b. B-84 (the phone's FTS) stays P2-12 slice 8 and P1-16 with the same mark rule.

NOT RECOVERABLE (said plainly): songs only streamed, plays, merges by file made while the key was empty, playlists of imports (information exists for a window, changing a person's list is not automatic).

RULINGS 15 Nov (relayed by the lead, PR #98): D6 CHANGED, the Cyrillic yo folds to ye (short i, yi and short u stay apart, moy and moi are two words, unless the recorded Russian titles of N-16 show otherwise); D7 CHANGED, the zero-width NON-joiner U+200C (the Persian half-space) becomes a SPACE, the bidi marks are removed with no gap; D1 accepted after a cross-check against Lucene (two rows added: heh with yeh above U+06C0 and heh goal U+06C1 fold to heh); D11 accepted (new item N-37, later); rehome.py only RE-POINTS song_file rows: it never renames, moves, retags or deletes a file of the Host's own music library (only a keeper file under Encore/ may be moved, and then by N-34 refile); survives_fold_whole is DEFINED by P2-25 slice 1 and N-34 slice 1 imports it and cannot start before it has merged.
